observed: the accepted ADR frames nondeterministic agentic genomics as a reproducibility problem and proposes binding agent identity, model, prompts, skills and tools into workflow/task identity
the lineage feature records workflow configuration, task executions, inputs/outputs, file checksums and source relationships
the ADR explicitly identifies unaddressed gaps such as signed bundles and enforced research/clinical tier boundaries
records.derived_pattern: For scientific or analytic workflows, preserve lineage from result back through exact inputs, code/configuration, transformations and execution identity; keep unimplemented validation gaps explicit.
records.behavioral_consequence: A derived scientific result should not inherit more confidence than its provenance and validation chain support; when a workflow has unimplemented assurance gaps, carry them into the result status.

observed: map handling is built around explicit coordinate frames, WCS, units and metadata
metadata warnings and coordinate/unit conversions are part of the map abstraction rather than presentation-only details
records.derived_pattern: Physical coordinates, frames, units and observation metadata are part of a scientific quantity's meaning, not optional formatting.
records.behavioral_consequence: Do not compare, transform or combine physical/geospatial quantities until units, coordinate/reference frames and observation metadata are compatible or explicitly converted.

observed: indicator classes validate inputs, check missing values, convert units and assign output metadata
the project follows climate-data conventions and exposes validation/health-check mechanisms
records.derived_pattern: Domain computation validity can depend on schema/convention compliance, missing-data policy and unit conversion before any numerical result is interpreted.
records.behavioral_consequence: For domain data, surface missingness, convention/schema, units and validation status separately from the computed value; a successful computation is not automatically a valid domain result.

observed: the note identifies discrepancies between Snow's map and a later digitization
its proposed corrections are explicitly argued as plausible/reasonable and generated by geometric interpolation
the reconstructed coordinates are therefore derived values rather than direct source observations
records.derived_pattern: Historical-data repair must preserve the distinction between source observation, detected inconsistency and reconstructed/interpolated value.
records.behavioral_consequence: Never silently replace missing or contradictory historical evidence with a reconstruction; label the reconstruction, method, assumptions and source discrepancy.

observed: the dataset documents projection and scale assumptions and notes known positional shifts
it distinguishes geodata from visual styling
it treats disputed boundaries as perspective-dependent and permits overlaps to represent conflicting claims
records.derived_pattern: Historical/geospatial representations carry resolution, projection, uncertainty and perspective; a single rendered boundary is not timeless or perspective-free ground truth.
records.behavioral_consequence: Qualify historical/geographic claims by date, source/perspective, spatial resolution and known uncertainty; preserve contested alternatives instead of forcing a single boundary when evidence is genuinely perspective-dependent.
